function.name: RouteIntent
function.description: Classify the user's intent into a workflow mode. Call this FIRST when the conversation's mode is unknown (tier-0) or when the user switches context (e.g. from discovery planning to editing an existing section). The chat backend swaps in a mode-specific system prompt + tool subset right after this call. Do NOT use this tool unless you actually need to change mode.

mode.description: discovery for 7-step paper planning; slr for literature search; edit for paper editing; rapikan for renumbering Fig/Table/Eq; revisi for revising a finished paper (abstract/section/data/paraphrase/grammar/translate); memory for memory management; casual for free chat.
